RESULT IN UNRELIABLE OR UNAVAILABLE GPS SIGNALS WITHIN RIGA FIR.

GNSS INTERFERENCE TO THE APPROPRIATE ATS UNIT.

FOR RNAV5, RNAV1 AND APPROACHES NOT AFFECTED.
